mixture.method: Independently audited observed-bin Hessian, local normal on the selected active-bound face, truncated by remaining box bounds; profile/model/initial sensitivities reported separately
mixture.calibration: No automatic total 95% or posterior interpretation. Active coordinates are fixed, disconnected profiles excluded; require a positive audited face Hessian and source-bound draw receipt. Compare coarse/fine propagated ranges and report their numerical change before interpreting them.

failure_policy: Stop at the first numerical or approximation failure; preserve all prior stages and failed logs.
